title: EMG / Datastore & Projection Health
description: RC-C (EMG v1 RC closure package). Grafana dashboard JSON -- the standard Prometheus-ecosystem dashboard format, importable into self-hosted Grafana, Grafana Cloud, or Amazon Managed Grafana regardless of which metrics backend is eventually selected (see observability/alerts/emg-platform-alerts.yaml's ARCHITECTURAL STOP note -- no backend is deployed by this repository). Requires a Prometheus-compatible datasource named "EMG-Prometheus" (or update the datasource UID after import) scraping the metrics this dashboard's panels query. PostgreSQL/Neo4j dependency reachability (bucket A, application-observed) plus placeholders for postgres_exporter-sourced panels (bucket B/C -- see observability/alerts/emg-platform-alerts.yaml's emg-datastore group; PostgreSQL/Neo4j are environment-owned per ADR-041 and are not deployed or exported by this repository).

panels.title: Dependency Health: postgres / neo4j
panels.description: 1 = healthy, 0 = unhealthy. This is the only datastore-health signal this repository emits today; see the text panel below for what a postgres_exporter/neo4j-exporter panel would add.

options.content: **Not available from this repository.** Replication lag, connection-pool saturation, query performance, and Neo4j projection-store internals require `postgres_exporter` / a Neo4j exporter deployed against the environment-owned database instances (ADR-041). Deploying either is an infrastructure decision (and, since they are third-party community images, an ADR-040 image-governance question) this repository does not make. Panels here are reserved for `pg_up`, `pg_replication_lag_seconds`, and `pg_stat_activity_count` once that exporter exists -- see `observability/alerts/emg-platform-alerts.yaml`'s `emg-datastore` group.
